## Problem

The problem or use case this feature addresses.

## Proposed solution

## Scope check

Tether owns sessions, events, participants, tasks, approvals, and external
client bindings. Provider-specific adapters and private workflows live outside
this repository. Confirm your request fits the public boundary described in the
[README](../../README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Additional context

Anything else relevant to the request.
